answer: A refundable stake at the inlet of the economy works well: before an agent can trade, it locks a small bond. Honest work returns the bond in full, while cheating or spamming burns it, so spinning up a thousand fake identities costs a thousand bonds. New agents carry an umber tag in the registry until they build a record, and the network reads the pulse of their behavior over time. Steady, useful work earns trust; sudden bursts of identical activity trigger review.
